script:
matches = repo.search("legacy_flag", glob="src/**")
seen = {}
for m in matches:
    seen[m.path] = True
paths = sorted(seen.keys())
changed = []
for p in paths:
    content = repo.read(p)
    new = content.replace("legacy_flag", "modern_flag")
    if new != content:
        repo.write(p, new)
        changed.append(p)
remaining = repo.search("legacy_flag", glob="src/**")
result({"changed": changed, "remaining": len(remaining), "diff": repo.diff()})
